reference_paths.description: No SAP background, wants SAP consultant role, 5 hrs/week
reference_paths.background: No SAP experience, business administration degree

expected_path.title: SAP Fundamentals
expected_path.rationale: Must start here — absolute beginner with no SAP background

expected_path.title: SAP Financial Accounting (FI) Basics
expected_path.rationale: Core FI module — prerequisite for FICO and consultant work

expected_path.title: SAP Controlling (CO) Fundamentals
expected_path.rationale: Core CO module — can run parallel with or after FI

expected_path.title: SAP Materials Management (MM)
expected_path.rationale: MM knowledge essential for consultant versatility

expected_path.title: SAP FICO Advanced Integration
expected_path.rationale: Advanced integration after both FI and CO are complete

expected_path.title: SAP Consultant Certification Prep
expected_path.rationale: Final step — certification prep after core modules

reference_paths.notes: At 5 hrs/week, this is a ~25 week plan. Must include SAP-101 first. SAP-104 must come after both SAP-102 and SAP-103. SAP-108 needs SAP-104 and SAP-106.

reference_paths.description: Cloud beginner, wants AWS Solutions Architect, 10 hrs/week
reference_paths.background: Basic IT knowledge, no cloud experience

expected_path.title: Cloud Computing Fundamentals
expected_path.rationale: Cloud basics first for someone with no cloud experience

expected_path.title: AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials
expected_path.rationale: AWS-specific foundations before architect-level content

expected_path.title: AWS Solutions Architect Associate
expected_path.rationale: Core target — the main certification goal

expected_path.title: Cloud Architecture Design Patterns
expected_path.rationale: Deepens architectural thinking beyond cert content

expected_path.title: AWS DevOps and CI/CD
expected_path.rationale: DevOps complements architect skills

reference_paths.notes: At 10 hrs/week, achievable in ~10 weeks. CLD-101 → CLD-102 → CLD-103 is the mandatory chain. CLD-108 and CLD-104 both require CLD-103.

reference_paths.description: Salesforce admin aspirant, no prior experience, 3 hrs/week (tight constraint)
reference_paths.background: No prior CRM or Salesforce experience

expected_path.title: Salesforce Platform Basics
expected_path.rationale: Platform fundamentals for complete beginner

expected_path.title: Salesforce Administration Essentials
expected_path.rationale: Core admin skills — the central course for this goal

expected_path.title: Salesforce Data Modeling and Management
expected_path.rationale: Data management is essential for admin certification

expected_path.title: Salesforce Flow and Automation
expected_path.rationale: Automation is a key admin exam topic

expected_path.title: Salesforce Reports and Dashboards
expected_path.rationale: Reporting is critical for admin work

expected_path.title: Salesforce Administrator Certification Prep
expected_path.rationale: Final cert prep — requires SF-102, SF-103, SF-104

reference_paths.notes: At 3 hrs/week, this is a ~34 week plan. The agent should flag that this is a long timeline. SF-106 requires SF-102, SF-103, AND SF-104.

reference_paths.description: AI/ML practitioner with Python basics, 8 hrs/week
reference_paths.goals: Build expertise in AI/ML for a career in data science
reference_paths.background: Knows Python basics, familiar with statistics fundamentals

expected_path.title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
expected_path.rationale: AI foundations — may be partially review but establishes baseline

expected_path.title: Python for Data Science and ML
expected_path.rationale: Data science Python stack — builds on their Python basics

expected_path.title: Machine Learning Algorithms Deep Dive
expected_path.rationale: Core ML — the heart of the data science path

expected_path.title: Deep Learning with TensorFlow and PyTorch
expected_path.rationale: Deep learning frameworks for advanced ML work

expected_path.title: Natural Language Processing (NLP)
expected_path.rationale: NLP is a high-demand specialization

reference_paths.notes: At 8 hrs/week, achievable in ~14 weeks. AI-101 → AI-102 → AI-103 → AI-104/AI-105 is the main chain. AI-104 and AI-105 both require AI-103.

reference_paths.description: Cybersecurity career changer, IT background, 6 hrs/week
reference_paths.goals: Transition into cybersecurity, get Security+ certified
reference_paths.background: 5 years IT support experience, familiar with networking basics

expected_path.title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
expected_path.rationale: Security foundations — IT background helps but cyber-specific concepts needed

expected_path.title: Network Security and Firewalls
expected_path.rationale: Network security builds on their IT/networking background

expected_path.title: CompTIA Security+ Certification Prep
expected_path.rationale: Direct path to Security+ — their stated certification goal

expected_path.title: Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing
expected_path.rationale: Practical security skills for career advancement

expected_path.title: Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst
expected_path.rationale: SOC analyst is a common entry point for career changers

reference_paths.notes: At 6 hrs/week, ~18 weeks. CS-108 requires both CS-101 and CS-102. CS-103 and CS-104 both require CS-102. Security+ cert is the primary goal.
